properties.name: Mawanella Maha Oya brick bridge
properties.event_basis: The selected Colombo–Kandy route is shown crossing the stream at Mawanella. The historical Public Works Department account identifies the brick bridge and the Provincial Council identifies the surviving bridge at this crossing. OSM way 316359067 occupies the same crossing and its nodes span the river.
properties.geometry_note: Retain the OSM geometry as a representation of the surviving crossing. The 1936 town symbol obscures the exact deck line and the imagery has a visible lateral offset of several metres. OSM endpoints define the modern mapped extent. Approaches are outside this review.
properties.source_locator: Main sheet, Mawanella road junction and blue stream, source pixels x3934–4264 y6945–7255, town symbol x4088 y7094
